dialog.body: Utilities billing, this is Tony. Good afternoon, how can I help?
Hi, yes, hello. Carmela Pellegrino. I'm at 428 Bellevue Avenue, and my water and sewer bill came and it's, hmm, let me see, it's way over what it's ever been. I think it's wrong.
Okay, let me pull that up. 428 Bellevue. Give me a second. Okay, I've got it. Yeah, this last quarter is quite a bit higher than the one before.
Quite a bit. It's nearly double. And nothing changed here, nobody's using more water. Sorry, hang on, can you stop that? He's stirring the sauce, I'm in the kitchen, it's loud. Sorry. Go ahead.
No problem, I can hear the pot going. So the reading went up quite a bit between the last two reads. That's the meter number, not an estimate.
Well, that's what I'm saying, the meter's wrong then. Or, no, maybe somebody read it wrong. Either way I'm not paying it as is.
Fair enough. Has anything been going on at the house? Leak, a running toilet, anything like that?

Well, we had a plumber out a few weeks ago. For the water heater. He didn't say anything about a leak, and I kept the receipt, it's right here on the counter. So if there was something he'd have found it, you'd think.
Good that you kept it. Hang on to that, because it shows what was done and when. If the plumber worked on a line, that can matter.
Okay. So how do I actually dispute it? Formally. Not just calling and complaining to you, no offense, Tony.

None taken. What you'd do is put it in writing to the billing office. Your name, the account address, the bill you're disputing, and why. Attach a copy of the plumber receipt. Don't send the original. They'll review it and can have the meter rechecked.

A copy, right. And do I pay in the meantime, or, wait, no, I don't want to ask that yet. Let me ask the other thing first. I want a breakdown by month. What we used. I'm trying to do a budget and I can't tell anything from one big number.

Sure, I can look at that. Our bills are quarterly, so I can give you the reads for each billing period, not true month by month. I can tell you the usage for the last several quarters, and you can see the trend.
Hmm. That's, okay, that's better than nothing. Go ahead, I've got a pen. Hold on, let me find paper. The back of this envelope, fine.
Okay. Take your time. Should I read them out, or would you rather I mail you a usage history so you've got it printed?
Mail it. Actually, no, read me the last two now so I can see how bad it is, and then mail the rest.
You got it. The previous quarter was roughly half of this latest one. I'll read the exact figures, ready?
Ready. Oh, and the number here is 401-555-0165, if you need to call me about the dispute. I'm home most afternoons.
Got it, 401-555-0165. Okay, here are the numbers.
